changes.title: Grouped derelicts no longer all offer story point recovery
changes.why: Survival offers story point recovery on 1 derelict in 5; the magnet offered it on every derelict without a recovery special.
changes.before: Every grouped derelict can be recovered for story points
changes.after: Grouped derelicts offer only the recoveries they already carry. Salvage a wreck you want by hand to get the normal 1 in 5 offer.
